title: Plan: Qew post-v1 roadmap
goal: Close evidence-backed gaps found by comparing Qew v1 with Hew v0.13.0 while preserving Qew's stricter safety and supply-chain choices.
done-when: Every child is closed or explicitly removed after fresh evidence.
Beads migration remains out of scope.

title: Record the Hew-to-Qew parity baseline
goal: Keep one concise evidence-backed comparison and explicit non-goals.
done-when: The audit names Qew strengths, real gaps, and rejected parity work.
The executable roadmap reproduces the dependency graph.

title: Add pinned PR CI and dependency maintenance
goal: Continuously prove Qew on supported Python versions and keep build inputs reviewable.
done-when: Pull requests run the behavioral suite on the supported Python floor and current release Python.
Actions are digest-pinned and Node-runtime deprecation warnings are removed.
Dependency update policy uses cooldowns and preserves reviewable pins.

title: Finish stable machine output and exit contracts
goal: Make every command safe to compose in agent loops.
done-when: Hooks, lifecycle, and PR commands expose versioned JSON.
Global repo/json flag placement has one tested rule.
The command spec matches claim, auth, validation, and indeterminate exits.

title: Extend untrusted-text findings to explicit reads
goal: Point reviewers to suspicious text without rewriting or hiding it.
done-when: Triage scans title and body; show scans title, body, and each displayed comment.
JSON identifies the exact source and human output annotates it.
Confusable data and emoji exceptions have pinned, reproducible provenance.

title: Finish work-state ordering and dedup guidance
goal: Make routine reads explain what is actionable and where dedup must continue.
done-when: List orders and annotates ready, claimed, blocked, and plan work deterministically.
Search warns when capped and hands zero vetted matches to triage search honestly.
Showing a plan names its next workable child.

title: Add native plan authoring and editor input
goal: Create parent plans and long-form work without raw GitHub commands or temporary body files.
done-when: Plan create supports initial children and canonical bodies.
Create and plan create support a safe editor path.
Writes preserve Qew approval, hierarchy, and verification rules.

title: Add guarded claim-time priority triage
goal: Let an explicitly selected untriaged issue be prioritized and claimed atomically enough for the GitHub boundary.
done-when: Start accepts a typed priority only when triage is required.
The priority write and claim are re-read and failures report partial state.
Forced claim stealing remains impossible.

title: Add explicit pacing to batch plan application
goal: Keep large plan application courteous and predictable under API limits.
done-when: Apply accepts a validated throttle duration with a documented default.
Dry-run never sleeps and resume retains existing checkpoint guarantees.

title: Warn on unmarked code-shaped issue and PR prose
goal: Preserve flags, paths, and command text in durable GitHub prose without rewriting author input.
done-when: Create and PR emit high-precision advisory warnings only.
Warnings name the suspect token and never alter bodies.

title: Publish a least-authority auto-triage example
goal: Offer an opt-in workflow for new public issues without expanding code or repository authority.
done-when: The example grants issues write only and exposes a closed command allowlist.
It skips trusted and bot-authored issues, never assigns P0/P1 automatically, and leaves ambiguity untriaged.
Issue content remains data under an explicit red-team walk.

title: Measure Qew agent-output token efficiency
goal: Replace the token-lean assumption with a reproducible comparison.
done-when: Fixtures compare ready, list, prime, and show with equivalent raw GitHub queries.
The report records regressions as well as wins and keeps runtime dependencies unchanged.
